description: Buyer personas for Empire Revenue OS GTM layer.

personas.title: Solo Founder
personas.description: Single founder building a product or service. Technical or creative. Needs revenue system to sell what they build.
personas.typical_pain: Can build but can't sell. No GTM motion.

personas.title: Agency Owner
personas.description: Owns a small agency selling custom services. Needs productized offers to scale beyond trading time for money.
personas.typical_pain: Selling custom work only. No repeatable offer. Revenue capped by time.

personas.title: Creator Operator
personas.description: Content creator with audience but no productized offer. Needs a monetization path beyond ads.
personas.typical_pain: Has audience, no product. Leaving money on the table.

personas.title: Local Service Owner
personas.description: Runs a local service business. Knows they need more customers but doesn't know how to systematize sales.
personas.typical_pain: Slow leads, no system, relying on word of mouth.

personas.title: Indie Hacker
personas.description: Built a product but can't sell it. Technical skills, no GTM skills.
personas.typical_pain: Product exists, no customers. Needs outreach and pricing.

personas.title: Music/Creator Business Operator
personas.description: Music professional or creative entrepreneur. Needs to monetize beyond gigs, streams, or commissions.
personas.typical_pain: Irregular income, no productized offer for their craft.
